binding_site_detail: Walker B / nucleotide-binding domain cleft between NACHT subdomains
mechanism: Sulfonylurea binds cleft connecting four NACHT subdomains + transition LRR; stabilizes inactive ADP-bound closed conformation; Walker A Arg interaction
assay_cells: BMDM; human whole blood; CAPS cells
IC50_KD: IC50=7.5-18 nM (assay-dependent); clinical doses not reached due to hepatotoxicity
key_residues: Walker A (R351 R578) + Walker B hydrophobic pocket
notes: Gold-standard structural tool. Mouse structure 7VTQ; human hexamer 7VTP. Prior clinical candidate.

binding_site_detail: Same NACHT inactive-state pocket as MCC950 class
mechanism: Intramolecular glue locks NACHT in inactive ADP-bound conformation
notes: First high-resolution crystal structure of NLRP3 NACHT with inhibitor.

binding_site_detail: Same pocket as MCC950 (closed NACHT conformation)
mechanism: Stabilizes inactive NLRP3 NACHT; clinical candidate from Jecure/Genentech
notes: Cryo-EM NACHT domain structure. Development stopped due to drug-induced liver injury.
Crystal structure 3.32 Å. Related to phenotypic screen compound series.

binding_site_detail: Same pocket region; unique tricyclic binding mode vs classic sulfonylurea
mechanism: Orally bioavailable; binds NACHT inactive state; distinct linker interactions vs MCC950
IC50_KD: Low nM whole blood; 30 mg/kg po full IL-1β inhibition in mouse peritonitis
key_residues: Walker A Arg578 + Asp662 (vs MCC950 Arg351)
notes: NOT a different binding site—same pocket different chemotype. Prior notes incorrectly separated NIC-12/NP3-562.

binding_site_detail: Same pocket as MCC950 (overlay RMSD 2.05 Å to 7VTP)
mechanism: Phenotypic screen hit; binds same hydrophobic pocket with different linker anchoring
notes: PDB 8WSM = compound 32 from same paper. Same pocket as MCC950 NOT a separate site.

clinical_status: Phase 1 completed; program discontinued post-Roche acquisition
notes: Completed Phase 1 2020 (NCT04015076). Roche acquired Inflazome 2020; PD trial withdrawn.

mechanism: Oral NLRP3 inhibitor; peripheral inflammation focus
notes: RIVULET trial recruiting for MACE-risk atherosclerosis.
Lilly acquired Ventyx 2026. Phase 2 pericarditis initiated Jan 2025.

binding_site_detail: NACHT ATPase—distinct chemotype from MCC950 but overlaps functional mechanism
clinical_status: Phase 2 (COVID pneumonia osteoarthritis per some sources)
notes: Same compound as OLT1177/dapansutrile. Listed here because it is often grouped with clinical NLRP3 inhibitors. Mechanistically closer to CY-09 than MCC950.

binding_site_detail: May block upstream K+ channel/trafficking; not validated direct NACHT binder
mechanism: Blocks NLRP3 inflammasome at high µM; mechanism debated
notes: Not a selective direct NLRP3 NACHT ligand like MCC950; included as historical comparator only.
